source: GitHub REST API version 2022-11-28: docs.github.com/en/rest/users/ssh-signing-keys (List SSH signing keys for a user: public, no scope) and docs.github.com/en/rest/users/emails with docs.github.com/en/rest/users/users (the account's verified addresses and its noreply one). What Check reads after GitHub answers unknown_key for a test commit (#5916): GitHub picks the account to verify an SSH signature against by the commit's email. The key is the test's own, put in for @KEY@. This device's key is listed.

reply.out: [{"email": "octocat@example.com", "verified": true, "primary": true, "visibility": "public"}, {"email": "old@example.com", "verified": false, "primary": false, "visibility": null}, {"email": "work@example.org", "verified": true, "primary": false, "visibility": null}]
